rules.statement: Acceptance is an element for the completion of a valid gift under Kandyan Law.
rules.supporting_quote: Having considered the statutory framework, the classic texts, and the decided cases, I am of the view that, while Kandyan Law does not require acceptance in the formal or technical sense known to Roman-Dutch Law, acceptance is nevertheless an element for the completion of a valid gift under Kandyan Law.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 4(2) of the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance
